name: haml 5 → 7 (haml 5.2.2 → 7.5.1, haml-rails 2.1.0 → 3.1.0; surround/succeed rewritten)
base_branch: upgrade/phase-13-ruby-3-4 (PR #235, head 845d5e5) — stacked PR; Phases 14 (Trixie) and 15 (Rails 8.0) run in parallel from the same base. Whichever of this PR and Phase 15 merges second needs a Gemfile.lock rebase (both touch the lock; this one moves only the haml and haml-rails lines)
rails_version: 7.2.4 (unchanged) — the plan lists this phase after Rails 8.1, but its only dependency is Phase 13; haml-rails 3.1.0 requires railties >= 5.1 and haml 7.5.1 requires Ruby >= 3.2, so it runs on Rails 7.2.4 without waiting

changes.haml: ~> 5.1 (5.2.2, 2021-05-29) → ~> 7.5 (7.5.1, 2026-09-01). Newest 7.x per `gem_lines.py haml --min 7` on 2026-10-25 (7.0.2, 7.1.0, 7.2.2, 7.3.1, 7.4.1, 7.5.1; all Ruby >= 3.2.0). New runtime dependencies prism (>= 1.1.0) and thor — both already locked (prism 1.9.0 via rdoc/rbs, thor 1.5.0 via railties); temple (>= 0.8.2) and tilt unchanged at 0.10.4 / 2.0.8
changes.haml_rails: ~> 2.0 (2.1.0) → ~> 3.1 (3.1.0, 2026-07-09; 3.0.0 was 2025-09-29). Runtime deps actionpack / activesupport / railties >= 5.1, haml >= 4.0.6
changes.removed_helpers: app/views/automation_scenarios/show.html.haml: `= surround '"', '"' do / = @automation_scenario.name` → `= "\"#{@automation_scenario.name}\""`; `= succeed ':' do / = s.object.display_name` → `= "#{s.object.display_name}:"`. Output is byte-identical: haml 5's XSS-aware surround/succeed escaped the front/back strings and html_safe'd the already-escaped block, giving `"Tom's "big" <scenario> & co"`; haml 7 escaping the interpolated string once gives exactly the same bytes. Grep of app/ lib/ config/ spec/ for precede / succeed / surround / capture_haml / haml_tag / haml_concat / page_class / list_of / find_and_preserve / init_haml_helpers / is_haml? / Haml::Helpers found only those two call sites
changes.options: no initializer set Haml::Template.options (grep of config/ for haml: nothing), so nothing to move to Haml::RailsTemplate.set_options. Effective Haml::RailsTemplate.options in production boot: {generator: Temple::Generators::RailsOutputBuffer, use_html_safe: true, streaming: true, buffer_class: "ActionView::OutputBuffer", disable_capture: true} — escape_html stays on, attr_quote is the haml 7 default (")
changes.attribute_quotes: accepted the haml 7 default double quote; no `Haml::RailsTemplate.set_options(attr_quote: "'")`. Reason: no spec, smoke spec or JSON schema asserts on raw HTML strings (feature specs use Capybara matchers, smoke specs parse with Nokogiri), the plan expects the change, and keeping the override would make every future haml upgrade diff against a non-default output
changes.views_unchanged: the other 18 .haml files under app/views (layouts application/auth/mailer, devise sessions/registrations/passwords/shared links, devise mailer ×5, about, privacy, landing_page, automation_scenarios/index, users/profiles/show) render identically on haml 7 without edits — see verification.baseline_diff
changes.specs: no spec changed. spec/smoke, spec/support/api_schemas untouched (no contract changed)

lock_method: Gemfile edited first, then inside the Phase 13 dev image (ruby 3.4.12, bundler 2.6.9): `bundle lock --update haml haml-rails --conservative`, `bundle lock --add-platform x86_64-linux`, `bundle lock --add-platform ruby`. Resolver demanded no transitive moves. Dev image rebuilt from the new lock (`Bundle complete! 44 Gemfile dependencies, 182 gems`, exit 0) and `bundle list` showed haml 7.5.1 / haml-rails 3.1.0 before any result below was trusted
